description: Review of the commit that made names read from the input never answer from Object.prototype, documented coverage (not the guarantee): an enum member with a literal value, `STOP = "skip"` in an `enum.Enum`, then `getattr(pytest, Kind.STOP.value)("x")`. The member is an assignment in a class body, so the contagion net reads `STOP` as a name holding the string `"skip"`, best effort: a WARN here. The real runner skips it.
